subject.title: fix(doctor): recover sibling moltbot.json config dropped on upgrade (#54200) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw accept bounded `openclaw doctor --fix` recovery for sibling `.openclaw/moltbot.json` after preserving canonical skeleton metadata?
rationale: The code path is a strong fix for a valid upgrade regression, but it intentionally restores a retired config filename and rewrites credential-bearing local config, which is a product and compatibility-policy choice.

options.title: Land Scoped Recovery After Metadata Fix
options.body: Preserve `update`/metadata keys from the skeletal canonical config, then accept the doctor-only compatibility exception while keeping runtime resolution canonical.

options.title: Require Stricter Fix-Mode Writes
options.body: Ask for missing-canonical sibling recovery to warn in read-only doctor and copy only under `doctor --fix` if maintainers want all writes gated by fix mode.

options.title: Decline Retired Filename Recovery
options.body: Close the PR and document manual migration if maintainers want `moltbot.json` to remain fully retired after the breaking change.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Recovery After Metadata Fix
recommendation.body: Preserve `update`/metadata keys from the skeletal canonical config, then accept the doctor-only compatibility exception while keeping runtime resolution canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: The config-path removal, doctor migration, and gateway startup guard history all point to this owner for the compatibility-policy decision.
